title: Wire ComputerHostDisk hydrate and publish on the host
description:
**Step 2 of the accepted `chatticus-fccc4e9a` host-disk plan.** `chatticus-4ac60c71` (Dynamo metadata) and `chatticus-8fe4c7e1` (host that runs) and `chatticus-2b3c4173` (customer ECR) are closed.

`ComputerHostDisk.hydrate` at `computer_host_worker` start; pack and publish before exit. One path: do not leave the dict readable beside host disk. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` drops "design target, not currently wired" when this lands — not before.

Snapshot library is to be wired, not deleted. No `/workspace` EFS. No prompt tuning. Snapshot **bucket** in the published template is `chatticus-bb908488` (step 4) — do not mix that customer-visible template change into this slice. Gherkin may fake object storage.

```
Feature: Computer host hydrates and publishes workplace disk

  Scenario: Host start hydrates from the published snapshot
    Given a computer with snapshot metadata in Dynamo
    When the customer computer host boots
    Then ComputerHostDisk hydrates the live root from the published snapshot

  Scenario: Host exit publishes a new snapshot generation
    Given unpublished writes on the live disk
    When the host worker finishes the job
    Then a snapshot is published and snapshot metadata is stored
```

## Done when

Hydrate-on-boot and publish-before-exit are specified in Gherkin and green. Dict is not a second workplace reader. No `customer-role.yml` edit. No live matrix rows beyond what this card needs.

comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with four holes closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-475335-host-disk` on `feat/475335-host-disk-hydrate-publish` (HEAD `41230a5`, not the primary clone). Hydrate-on-boot, publish-before-exit, Front Door metadata, `FilesystemSnapshotStore` in Gherkin, no `customer-role.yml` — those stand.

**Closed on authorize:**
1. **This is not step 3 or step 5.** Do not gut `ControlPlane.read_workspace` / computerless file tools / `computer.workspace`. Do not rewrite `computer_snapshots.feature` onto host disk in this PR. Dict remains what computerless tools reach until the file-tools-on-host card.
2. **ARCHITECTURE.md:** Remove "Fargate host worker never publishes or hydrates" and "workspace_ready without hydrating". Do **not** delete the dict layer or claim agent tools reach `/workspace`. Do not leave the 3e72dc "open decision" sentence (host disk is decided on `chatticus-fccc4e9a`).
3. **Relocate Gherkin needs two workers.** Relocate to the same `computer-host-1` is not a hydrate story. Recycle-with-file-bytes is in scope only if Then-steps read **host disk** after hydrate, not `plane.read_workspace`.
4. **No snapshot bucket env → skip, do not crash.** Live `browser_open` must keep working. Do not default publish/hydrate to the Anthus `ChatticusSnapshots` bucket.

Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/321 **request changes**. Do not merge.

Composer 2.5 review found two blockers:

1. **Auth:** `POST /host-worker/computers/snapshot/hydrated` and `…/publish` never call `_assert_worker_id_matches`. A co-hosted worker can publish as another host.
2. **False-green publish:** Gherkin marks `disk_dirty` by writing the messaging store in the step. Production host writes never set that flag, so `publish_before_exit` is a no-op for real disk mutations.

Skip-when-unset is in-process PASS; live development acceptance is **blocked** until this lands and deploys (expected). Worktree stays `/tmp/chatticus-475335-host-disk`.
